name: Commute planner
description: Roadmap Epic 2M. The first real out-of-process plugin and the reference example for building others: tell the home you are heading somewhere (or must be there by a time) and it computes the traffic-aware ETA and the latest time to leave, publishing them as a virtual 'Commute' device. Origin is the runtime site location (Epic 2K); the traffic backend is a replaceable connector (offline simulator by default, TomTom when a key is set). Declares internet:true, so it also demonstrates resource-aware gating actually launching a plugin.
